mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a warm 77 degrees, feeling like 81, under mainly clear night skies. Over at Badger Prairie County Park, you can enjoy a lovely view of the waxing crescent moon, though the space station is sitting tonight out with no visible passes.

In city news, Verona is continuing its push for local sustainability. Apartment dwellers can easily compost by dropping food waste off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue, while homeowners can take advantage of solar group buy programs and Alliant Energy's community solar options. Additionally, the city is replacing street lights with energy-efficient LED bulbs on Verona Avenue to save energy.

We have some great local events coming up. On Saturday, July 18th, head down to the Wisconsin State Capitol for the Dane County Farmer's Market, enjoy the Mount Horeb Art Fair, or catch live music at Paddy Mac's, Bailey's Run, and Lake Louie. Plus, mark your calendars for July 22nd to visit Verona's own Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash at Old PB and Whalen Road on Friday, July 10th, at 7:26 AM. A bicyclist from Oshkosh sustained minor injuries, and a Verona man was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

For today's sweet treat, the Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie! Since the store is currently closed, you will want to head over once they open their doors at 10:00 AM to grab your scoop. Tomorrow's flavor is still a mystery, so make today's count!
